stories.ltme_summary: ChatGPT Is Eating the World reports a new copyright suit by owners of some Elvis songs against Anthropic. The filing is ABE EPE LLC v. Anthropic, described as the eighth AI music copyright suit filed this year by Adams & Reese. The commentary puts the running total of AI copyright suits at 157.
stories.hook: Adams & Reese files eighth AI music copyright suit this year against Anthropic over Elvis songs

stories.title: The Defense Bar In The Age Of AI: Running A Red Queen’s Race?
stories.ltme_summary: Legal Tech Monitor republishes a commentary by a former defence lawyer on how AI may change defence firms. The author argues personal injury contingency fee firms hold an advantage and that defence firms may need to change their approach to keep up. The piece was first published in Above the Law.
stories.hook: Former defence lawyer says defence firms must change how they use AI to keep pace with plaintiff firms

stories.title: AI Use In Law Firms: There’s Reality. And There’s What Management Wants It To Be.
stories.ltme_summary: Legal Tech Monitor republishes a commentary arguing that surveys of lawyers' AI use overstate adoption. The author cites a Visier study reporting that 48 per cent of respondents, as the extract states, and says audience show of hands tells a different story. The piece questions management's view of AI use in firms.
stories.hook: Commentator questions surveys of lawyers' AI use, citing a Visier study and a 48 per cent figure
